name: Midare Setsugetsuka ~Tsukiyo no Inbu, Kyouki no Chigiri~
original_name: 乱れ雪月華 ～月夜の淫舞、狂気の契り～
source:
Part 1:

Reexperience the tale of “Petals of the Wild Snow Moon ~Faint, Fluttering Snowfall~” in a series of side stories told from the perspective of Kiichi Kusakabe.
Will the truth behind Kiichi’s transformation... finally come to light?!

Part 2:

Two months have passed from the events in the previous part.
The baby Yukina was pregnant with that she believed had been killed has, in fact, safely grown into a healthy baby.
Kiichi must have failed to perform the technique he had used on her...
But how could a gifted ninja like Kiichi mess up like that? It seems unfathomable.
And how could the serious and kind Kiichi do something so insane?
The truth has to be out there somewhere...
With this in mind, Keiji sets out, as the master of the ways of Kusakabe-ryuu, to uncover the truth about his brother.
That’s when Keiji encounters a woman he has met once before... in bed.

[From [url=https://www.johren.games/games/download/midaresetsugetsukatsukiyono-ja/]Johren[/url]]
translation:
第一部分：

从日下部喜一的视角，通过一系列外传故事重新体验《狂野雪月花～飘零的雪花～》。喜一变身背后的真相，终于要揭晓了吗？！

第二部分：

距离上一部分的事件已经过去两个月。由希奈曾以为已经死去的胎儿，实际上平安长大，成为健康的婴儿。看来喜一没能成功施展对她使用的术法……但像喜一这样的天才忍者，怎么会犯下这种错误？实在令人难以置信。认真又善良的喜一，又怎么会做出如此疯狂的事？

真相一定隐藏在某处……于是，身为日下部流派宗师的庆司开始调查有关兄长的真相。就在这时，他在床上遇到了一个曾经见过的女人……
